title: Tamsin and the Sigil
author: Felix Whitlock
blurb: Dominic Eriksen, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
